description: This file contains a Kotlin extension function for a BaseFragment, which displays a dialog allowing users to move notes to different notebooks within an Android application. It handles dialog creation, selection logic, and navigation actions.

methods.name: showMoveToNotebookDialog
methods.description: An extension function for BaseFragment that shows a dialog allowing users to select a notebook to move given notes into. It handles dialog display, user selection, and navigation to manage notebooks.
